steps.why: typecheck failed because the tsc binary is not in node_modules/.bin, so npx tried to fetch the unrelated 'tsc' package. Installing typescript without saving it makes the local tsc available.
The test script runs ./out/test/runTest.js, which doesn't exist until the TypeScript sources are compiled. This is the standard VS Code extension build into out/.

exclusion.reason: npm install crashed with an npm-internal error (timeout, exit 124), so tsc was never installed and typecheck failed; the test script then failed because ./out/test/runTest.js was never compiled. This is a missing install/build artifact, not a credential, private registry, or unsupported toolchain, although the VS Code extension test runner may later need a downloaded VS Code.
